sources.claim_summary: NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (HTTP 403); the underlying Human Dignity Trust Malaysia country profile documents that same-sex conduct is criminalised under Penal Code Section 377A (up to 20 years plus whipping), that no legal gender recognition exists, and that the dual civil-Syariah court system applies Sharia jurisdiction to Muslims only.
